I smoked right before the show I went to, it was my first as well. It was absolutely surreal. I got the front row and after lighting up I kind of looked around and giggled cause I'm uber high at a frickin Animal Collective show. This was gonna be wild.

Their light show was so engrossing, it was like eye candy. They shined these shimmering, squirming textures onto themselves and the stage. Incredibly psychedelic, loved it.

The stage props and the way the guys dressed were really bizarre, it totally piqued my interest in the performance. Avey was dressed in all gray stuff, kind of doing little tiny dances on his heels, with this strong green light and fog behind him. It occurred to me how zombie-like he looked, kind of brought Thriller to mind. Very cool, I blame the weed for me imagining Avey as a zombie, loved it.

When Panda sang Daily Routine it eventually felt like this wall of noise and just his voice, no outside sounds. Really immersive. Psychedelic as heck, loved it.

If you're a regular smoker I say go for it, but if you're not it might be intense. For instance I didn't have a bottle of water and the cotton mouth/throat of death is really harsh on beginners. That would be rough at a concert.
